prompt: Character turnaround of SKIP, Hop's tag-team partner: an original rabbit mascot, leaner and taller than Hop, cool, focused, a little smug. Soft bean-shaped head with short rounded muzzle, glossy almond eyes with icy blue irises, calm half-lidded confident look, small rounded triangle nose, subtle closed-mouth smirk, no teeth. Cool white-grey fur (#EEF2F7) with soft grey shading, pink inner ears. BOTH ears tall and perfectly upright, noticeably longer than Hop's, with a small gold hoop earring on one ear. Fresh clean 90s street style, not punk, mirroring Hop's outfit in swapped colors: red sweatband headband (#EF4444), small round mirrored shades with purple-blue lenses worn low on the nose, oversized blue mesh basketball jersey (#3B82F6) with white piping and number 2, red basketball shorts with white side stripes to the knees, chunky blue-white-red high-top sneakers, red wristband. Smooth relaxed posture, A-pose. Original character for a 90s-arcade neon rhythm brawler, same style as the hero rabbits: premium designer vinyl art toy look, modern stylized 3D console game character, cute but cool, smooth semi-gloss materials, soft studio lighting, subtle rim light, clean readable silhouette, bright saturated arcade colors, NOT a flat classic cartoon. Plain light grey background, full body, front and back and side views.
